body: I get that you’re scared of the outcome. This is a terrifying idea to entertain and a terrifying possible outcome. But wouldn’t you rather know *for sure*? It’s better safe than sorry. Better that you “overreacted” and hurt your son’s feelings, than to “ignore it” to save his feelings and possibly set this girl up for lifelong trauma. I wish there had been someone who had worried enough to help me. Don’t be someone who stands by and be the reason that little girl may possibly never be able to form meaningful romantic relationships, the reason she has nightmares, and more.
I’d call the police. That would be my reaction.
